family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: identify the trustee at the bank-meeting cut-off despite signed papers and a later administrative message. The blind review verifies that an affirmative hold preserves the incumbent and that registered release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement (family_a/review/blind-review.md). Fresh excerpt readings verify the two-Source instrument-and-disposition routes and reject a proposed shorter route (family_a/review/necessity.md). The order-only sibling preserves the key and ordinary context (family_a/review/matched-sources.json). Bank paperwork, an ordinary kinship edge and other administrative details are incidental. The latest note, name frequency and automatic promotion of signed papers are plausible shortcuts; one two-person office and explicit terms bound the result.
family_assessments.overlap: A shares dependent proof with B and C. Unlike D, it varies whether a signed act became effective, not the scope of an act whose effectiveness is fixed.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: attribute a native parentage statement using a separately maintained attendance field. Completing the field binds the statement to one named speaker (family_b/review/outputs/comparison.json); the incomplete field leaves two compatible speakers while preserving the ordinary parent edge (family_b/review/agreement.json). The forward and export share an informant, and forward-only masks do not establish the speaker (family_b/review/mask-results.json). Proof deletions defeat the target without removing unaffected kinship (family_b/review/proof-deletions.json). The clerk's original-document sighting supports an ordinary relationship through a distinct information path. A completeness check followed by selection of the first contact can reproduce the graph delta; the two-name desk convention limits generalisation.
family_assessments.overlap: Like C, B requires withholding when a discriminating identifier is incomplete. B resolves a speaker rather than a trust endpoint. F keeps the identity records complete and instead varies an ancillary label.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: allocate an operative designation to one of two trusts. Changing the custody register's parent-deed reference switches the supported endpoint; obscuring it leaves both allocations viable, and both readers withhold both target endpoints (family_c/review/outputs/comparison.json; family_c/review/agreement.json). Independent excerpt review verifies a three-Source proof, and whole-file masks defeat the target while preserving ten ordinary edges (family_c/review/proof-deletions.json). Shared trustees, a wish, expenses and meeting details provide context. First-trust, fixed-trust and assign-both heuristics fail across the variants, but two parallel settlements and one decisive register entry bound the inference.
family_assessments.overlap: C shares joint proof and restraint with A and B. It verifies preservation of a rich ordinary graph, not a separate effect of administrative context, placement or load.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: determine which earlier beneficiary provision survives an effective, scoped amendment. The admitted register records that the sole locator change switches the earlier survivor while preserving the replacement, trust and unaffected relationships. The saved keys attach joint scope proof, and the closing audit independently verified the grouped proof. Individual fact-level deletions remain incomplete, and reading the locator alone can reproduce the graph without establishing that proof. Separate office and beneficiary provisions and the variation's effective date supply context; unrelated kinship was not part of this comparison.
family_assessments.overlap: A varies effectiveness while holding the instrument fixed; D fixes effectiveness and varies express reach. D does not establish coverage of other amendment mechanisms or multigeneration restatements.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: resist merging distinguishable people when an ancillary display label collides. The admitted register records that one populated label change leaves both exact named graphs and their separately attached proof sets invariant. Masking an exact identity entry defeated its dependent edge. The first excerpt reader entered the wrong structured surname despite identifying the correct person in prose; an independent identical-packet repeat returned the correct surname. Positional pairing remains a shortcut. The working index is incidental to authoritative stable references and identity links; the result does not cover colliding authoritative identifiers.
family_assessments.overlap: B tests missing speaker attribution; F tests a nonunique display label in complete records. C also verifies graph invariance, but not invariance under a label collision or the risk of attaching another person's proof.

gaps.finding: Dependent proof recurs across the admitted histories, and B and C independently verify withholding under incomplete identifiers. F adds a bounded complete-record collision. This is repeated exposure, not coverage of broader identity conflicts, interacting gaps or all fact-level deletions. L's sighting-content limit is technically qualified but is not admitted coverage.

A tests one explicit release condition and D one effective selective replacement. They do not isolate status among retained counterparts, event date versus report date, or carry-forward across instrument generations. I's record-basis comparison is technically qualified, not admitted. Prior development approval for other designs does not establish technical qualification or admission.

B verifies that a relay and export do not supply another informant. It does not test two genuinely independent, comparable assertions in conflict. E reproduced its contrast but was returned at the documentary-realism gate; E0 and E1 are diagnostic only. W remains a distinct eligible office-account design, not verified coverage.

C verifies preservation of ten ordinary edges under a focal intervention, and A isolates presentation order once. X has a technical dossier for native correspondence support, not for burial, placement or load. There is no verified intermediate full-file workload. Source count and length are descriptive without a matched workload contrast.

No admitted file distinguishes a planned check, actual item receipt and the scope of an affirmative inspection through independent records. T would test their consequences for supplied-text graph support, not whether an instrument was delivered or took legal effect. It is not a factorial interaction study.

Finding or requesting records, acquiring images and recovering physical text require a scope change. Represent those limits only through the supplied file; do not score retrieval, OCR or practitioner outcomes.

result.portfolio_summary: The packet records eight technically qualified independent development histories: A, B, C, D and F retain human admission; I, L and X have technical dossiers awaiting human review. Count each history once, not once per sibling, mask or pilot condition. T is the highest-priority new construction proposal because there is no scientifically verified 21–50 Source file and because T tests a specific evidentiary mistake: treating receipt or a planned check as verification. The lower-cost priority is to use the existing I, L and X dossiers to avoid redundant construction, without counting them as admitted coverage. T would bring the technical count to nine only if individually qualified. Ten is a planning target, not a quota. No Y or Z is proposed: independent disagreement is a real gap, but W remains a compact candidate and E's return does not justify another near-duplicate. No provider results are available, and this plan makes no performance claim or request for live extraction.

evidence_dependencies: Verify one exact joint route: the frozen worksheet fixes the pair, orientation and item reference; the independent intake entry ties that item to the checked folder; and the signed finding identifies the same folder and worksheet version and affirms agreement of the full-record parent and child entries, not merely the presence or identity of a certificate. Verify scope and timing from the passages actually needed. Attach all necessary passages to the same edge.

Fresh readers test the exact joint excerpts, each singleton and each two-component route. Proper fact deletions remove the named-row link, actual folder membership or substantive agreement in turn, including any copies of the deleted fact. Independently rederive each diagnostic graph. Mask the dispatch schedule separately and confirm it is not doing the work of the intake record.

Assign separate readers to the outgoing and receiving sections before exposing them to cross-section material. Ask what is positively supported, what is pending and which join is missing. Use other, isolated readers for two independent, complete reconstructions from every Source. No reader sees the intended key, counterpart diagnostics or another reader's output before submitting an independent reading. Do not combine section keys in lieu of full-file reads.

Audit both directions for every edge and every apparent relationship assertion. In particular, test whether a dispatch line, return receipt, unscoped adviser summary, reporting snapshot, copied statement or ordinary sighting bypasses the intended route. Verify ordinary singleton proofs and the separate trust join on their own merits; never demand redundant citations.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The full file licenses the focal named edge through an affirmative check joined to the exact named worksheet row and the actual contents of the checked folder. Receipt of another item does not license its proposed relationship and does not contradict it. Removing any indispensable focal fact defeats that route; removing only the dispatch schedule preserves it. Report exact complete-graph and same-edge proof recovery separately. Section readings diagnose local insufficiency, not an effect of volume or placement.
genres_and_provenance: Outgoing practice transfer (3 Sources): the client's transfer authority, retained by both practices to delimit the transfer; the former caseworker's frozen pending-check worksheet, retained to communicate unfinished comparisons; and the outgoing records team's dispatch schedule, retained to account for what it released. The worksheet lists named propositions and item references but makes no parentage finding.

Successor intake and advice (5 Sources): the intake team's actual item-to-folder record, kept to track custody; the checking adviser's signed result, kept to document the inspection actually completed; the holder's signed return receipt, retained to account for original papers without certifying their contents; a separate family-record sighting retained for an independently relevant contact check; and the lead adviser's dated briefing note, kept to set scope and cut-off without summarising the key.

Third-party valuation (4 Sources): the adviser's valuation instruction, the valuer's native access correspondence, the valuer's dated report and the valuer's invoice, retained in the valuation file to define the assignment, arrange access, substantiate an asset figure and account for the fee. Attendance and access are not evidence of kinship or office.

Estate accounting (7 Sources): the bank's dated balance response and separate transaction statement, supplied for different balance and reconciliation questions; a creditor's settlement statement; the estate administrator's disbursement ledger and separately retained third-party payment receipt; and the accountant's reconciliation and outstanding-query note. These arise from establishing funds, debts and actual disbursements, and resolving remaining account differences. Payment records do not confer relationships.

Continuing trust (6 Sources): the trustees' retained governing extract and meeting minute; the trust administrator's separately held signed current schedule and reporting snapshot; the provider's holdings statement; and the trust accountant's fee allocation. They serve distinct governance, current-provision, reporting, investment and cost-allocation purposes. The extract and schedule supply a separate ordinary join through an express rule and local reference, not a second experimental contrast.
design.intervention: Score one natural full file. Use predeclared review-only item-membership, substantive-finding and named-worksheet masks or fact deletions, plus a dispatch-only mask as a negative control. Do not score these as siblings. A changed receipt or folder reference in isolation would risk making genuinely interdependent custody and review records inconsistent or making a different inspection appear to have occurred. Prefer the independently reconstructable natural case to manufacturing a matched clerical error.
invariants: One frozen worksheet, exact name policy, supplied record inventory, chronology and briefing cut-off. Distinguish dispatch, intake, inspection, return and receipt into the briefing file.

The unrelated family and trust relationships have sufficient proof independent of the focal family-check chain. Target-only diagnostics retain those proofs and the same meanings for payment, access and administrative roles.
negative_controls: A received but unchecked item listed in the same frozen worksheet supplies no relationship and no denial, even though its receipt is documented.

An independently sighted ordinary family edge and the independently joined trust relationships survive focal diagnostics. Attendance, disbursement and reporting cues cannot substitute for proof of relationship.
design.scenario: A successor adviser receives records from several workstreams for one interim handover. The former practice's proposed family checks and the recipient's physical intake are locally coherent, but neither establishes parentage. The substantive reviewer certifies match results only for the contents of one actual inspection folder. The complete graph also requires reconstruction of unrelated family and trust relationships elsewhere in the file.
shortcut_heuristics: Test planned-equals-verified, received-equals-verified, batch-wide sign-off, newest-record and administrative-role promotion. A token match may help locate a record but cannot replace the scoped finding or actual item membership.

Check filenames, headings, order, parallel row positions, wrapper text and repeated passages for an unintended answer cue or shorter route. A review-only reorder can expose position dependence but is not a scored condition. Preserve natural filing order in the primary file.
success_criteria: Before authoring, a documentary review justifies each of 23–27 proposed Sources by its creator, distinct business purpose, custody and availability at the briefing. The nominal 25-Source inventory survives without arbitrary splitting, padding or a contrived reason to omit a normally retained controlling record.

Two isolated full-file readers recover the same complete exact-name graph, or disagreements are independently adjudicated and any required revision is reread in full. Section readers identify the missing link rather than settling the local focal claim. Fresh excerpt and mask readers verify the joint and invariant proofs, distinguish pending from disproved, and reject adverse competing routes.

Verify intact full-context delivery to both review tracks and exact passage attribution, and record actual review and audit effort. Stop if natural recordkeeping makes the check self-contained, if its wording cannot support the named proposition without unseen material, if the competing routes cannot be resolved, or if whole-file reconstruction cannot be sustained.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimate 59–83 working scientific sessions: 28–38 for authoring and integration, 18–25 for two isolated full-file reads plus separate section, excerpt and mask review, and 13–20 for adjudication and audit. Allow 3–5 additional owner sessions for inventory, realism and capacity decisions. Assumes one natural condition, at most one pre-lock revision and independent rereads after any change affecting proof.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominally 25 separately justified Sources across five workstreams (3 + 5 + 4 + 7 + 6), with a permitted range of 23–27. The focal proof crosses the transfer and successor records; the trust proof crosses separately maintained governance and administration material. The intermediate tier is justified by the actual briefing inventory, not the number of records needed for one focal edge.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse B's provenance and attribution checks, C's independently rederived mask keys and invariant-graph audit, and existing exact-passage and same-edge sufficiency scoring. Add section-local diagnostic reads and intact full-file transport checks without changing the scoring contract.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use the existing parent_of predicate for the focal proof and existing Person/Trust predicates for other supported relationships. Worksheet proposals, receipt, inspection, missing records, office-adjacent tasks and open questions belong in the companion register. Do not infer spouses from shared children or siblings from common parentage.
risks_and_limits: Its weakest link is whether a competent reviewer would naturally record substantive results by folder without recopying the exact named findings. If that practice cannot be plausibly documented in the supplied file, stop rather than engineer a reference convention.
One natural file cannot estimate a causal effect of inspection scope, document volume or placement. The controls qualify the proof and describe performance on this file only.

A shorter honest file is preferable to a padded intermediate file, but it does not meet this intermediate proposal. Record the workload gap rather than rounding up or treating chunked review as full-context reconstruction.

assumptions: The outgoing worksheet is a credible handover record of checks still due. Intake records physical receipt and folder allocation independently of the reviewer, who directly compares the full entries to the fixed worksheet and makes an affirmative, folder-bounded finding.

The checked and pending folders serve ordinary intake and review purposes. A dispatch list records what the sender expected to send; it does not establish the actual contents of a folder created by the recipient.

The originals used for this check were returned under the documented handling arrangement, and usable copies are not part of the briefing pack. The retained written finding and its cross-references must be sufficient in the supplied text. Readers must not inspect, infer from or request unseen records.

Twenty-five Sources is a provisional inventory for this specific retainer, not an estimate of normal file size. Each Source must survive a separate creation, custody, receipt and meeting-relevance check.
grounding.documentary_situation: The outgoing practice's frozen worksheet lists proposed named parentage comparisons, not findings. The successor's intake team records which items actually went into each inspection folder. A different reviewer records that the full-record parentage entries in a specified folder matched the corresponding worksheet comparisons, without recopying the worksheet or certifying the rest of the intake. Another received item is awaiting inspection at the cut-off. The adviser receives the worksheet, intake record and signed finding in readable form.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile a transferred estate file before an interim accounts handover, with a separate continuing-trust workstream. Distinguish completed family-record checks from pending checks without deciding entitlement, distribution or legal parentage.
grounding.meeting_purpose: At one dated cut-off, identify the relationships the received papers actually support and record outstanding checks separately from valuations, accounts and trust governance.
practitioner_unknowns: Whether a successor practice would naturally retain a version-specific, folder-level affirmative check rather than duplicate the names and outcomes in a self-contained sighting note.
Whether intake allocation and substantive review would actually be recorded separately, and whether the return arrangement and pending inspection are credible at the selected cut-off.
Whether the estate, valuation and continuing-trust records would naturally come together for this briefing without splitting ordinary records or adding redundant material.

objective.coverage_gap: T tests the scope of a completed inspection, not I's transcription basis, L's visible parentage field, X's firsthand message, or J's linkage to an operative delivery. Record authority, available field type and legal effect are not varied. The check is substantive but evidentiary only; it does not appoint, confer or terminate a role. Unlike C's choice of trust endpoint, the join determines which propositions were actually verified and which remain open.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may treat a proposed comparison, a dispatch entry or physical receipt as substantive confirmation. It may also recover the right edge but cite only the worksheet or a generic check note, omitting the passage that puts the named item inside the verified scope.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: On a locked full file, the named parentage proposition is supported only where the proposed pair, actual folder membership and affirmative substantive check join. Receipt outside the checked scope leaves the other proposition open. Exact recovery and sufficient same-edge evidence disconfirm the predicted extraction errors on this file. Reject the design if isolated sections can settle the focal claim, the finding attests only to receipt, or the retained texts do not prove the exact named relationship.

proposals.title: Which received records did the verification actually cover?

stopping_criteria: Stop T at inventory review if fewer than 23 or more than 27 genuinely distinct, relevant Sources are needed for the retainer. Do not split records, add plausible-looking filler or discard controlling material to meet the count.

Stop or defer if ordinary possession at the cut-off, independent provenance, the affirmative inspection's scope or the exact proof cannot survive independent review after one permitted revision. Do not repair the design by assuming outside law, unseen records or retrieval.

Do not count T as technically qualified until the locked file passes both complete independent readings, the separate section and exact-proof diagnostics, adjudication, bidirectional audit and intact full-context checks. Stop if reviewer capacity or full-context transport fails; chunking is not a substitute.

Keep the work development-only. Preserve all prior hypotheses, decisions, admitted keys and scores. Do not add redundant replacements to fill the ten-family target or treat this plan as release, admission or extraction authorisation.
